resolutions.conclusion: The unit is an exact (source namespace, source record ID) pair. The script first retains separate database records using database+source+ID, then merges the two databases using source+ID alone. Retained pairs are MED:PMID identifiers and an ETH:771510 record returned by Europe PMC. These are neither DOI-deduplicated articles nor independently verified unique studies.
limits_and_missing_evidence: No expansion of the ETH namespace to an unverified document type is needed.
Final DOI/title and version reconciliation remains a separate operation.

resolutions.old_text: The targeted narrative search update on 11 October 2026 added to the historical searches. It used four query families in PubMed E-utilities and Europe PMC, web searches and citation chaining. Its identifiers were kept separate from the August records. The API queries returned 498 hits in total. Merging records within each database left 488 records representing 281 stable source identifiers, before final reconciliation by DOI or title. resolutions.new_text: The targeted narrative search update on 11 October 2026 added to the historical searches. It used four query families in PubMed E-utilities and Europe PMC, web searches and citation chaining. Its identifiers were kept separate from the August records. The API queries returned 498 hits in total. Merging records within each database left 488 records. Grouping these by source namespace and record ID yielded 281 distinct pairs: MED identifiers shared across PubMed and Europe PMC, plus an ETH identifier returned by Europe PMC. These pairs preceded final reconciliation by DOI or title. The returned API identifiers and request records were preserved. Only the top web-search results were retained, without a total-hit count for calculating coverage. The Evidence Companion records decisions about candidates, duplicates and levels of full-text access.

resolutions.conclusion: A cluster is a connected component under exact shared identifier strings. The catalogue code creates keys for source IDs, DOI, PMID/MED, PMCID/PMC, other supported indexed identifiers, and normalised URLs; explicitly documented URL-to-DOI aliases can add a shared DOI key. Matching is transitive through union-find. Titles are normalised only to flag possible duplicates, which remain separate.
limits_and_missing_evidence: Different versions or alternate URLs can remain separate, and non-study/background pages remain discovery candidates.
The retained catalogue has 281 API nodes plus 182 web candidates, 11 merge events and 452 components. Counts do not establish unique studies.
Supported code paths include OpenAlex IDs, but the retained nodes contain no OpenAlex ID keys; no claim that such a key produced a merge is made.

resolutions.new_text: The Evidence Companion preserves the 51 exact query strings, API requests and translations, candidate decisions and reasons, source-access and reading scopes, and identities of the raw responses. Across search channels, the catalogue contains 452 groups formed by linking identical source identifiers, DOIs or normalised URLs, including documented URL-to-DOI links. resolutions.conclusion: Adopted decisions denotes the separate main_protocol_decisions.json record, especially its adopted_evaluation_details and P1-P5 adopted_closures. These document no additional tuning; calibration on routine validation; conditional paired-seed statistics; cost and inference measurement boundaries; bounded security wording; and failure/retry handling. The campaign manifest hashes this record, while cell_config inherits runnable model/training settings from reference/fullsize_B.json and stage_cell seals job/app inputs.
limits_and_missing_evidence: The decision record explicitly says it is not a runnable configuration or security certification.
The proposed wording says the decisions were documented and linked by identity; it does not claim that byte identity alone proves every methodological decision was implemented.
